crisis.title: Help For Adoptive Families In Crisis
crisis.description: We are a Revive Behavioral Healthcare program. We have developed an Adoption Wraparound Service with a love-based unique methodology. This is an intense trauma-responsive educational program for adoptive parents on how to better understand and care for their adopted child.
crisis.entityDefinition: Love Pathways Wraparound (Love-Based Education for Adoptive Families) is a love-based, trauma-responsive adoption wraparound program of Revive Behavioral Healthcare that supports adoptive families across 10 counties in California.
crisis.noCostBefore: Wraparound means the help comes to your family instead of your child going somewhere else. A team forms around you, made up of people from our program and people you already trust, and together you build one plan.
crisis.quote: When a family is supported, a child can heal.

expertise.quoteText: Your child at home, with a team around your family.
expertise.description: High Fidelity Wraparound is California’s team-based model for children with complex needs. Instead of sending your child somewhere else for help, a team forms around your family, and it includes people you choose yourself.
expertise.feature1Text: A Facilitator who leads the team, a Family Specialist, a Parent Partner who has lived what you are living, and the relatives, neighbors or teachers you want in the room. They meet together, not separately.
expertise.feature2Text: Not a folder of referrals. One plan, built on what your family already does well, that everyone on the team works from and reviews with you.
expertise.feature3Title: Four Phases, Then We Step Back
expertise.feature3Text: Engagement, Plan Development, Implementation, Transition. The goal is your family holding this without us, with supports that stay after we are gone.

qualifies.title: We're here for families like yours
qualifies.intro: If any of this feels familiar, Love Pathways was built for your family. No forms to pass, no hoops to jump through.
qualifies.point1: You're raising a child you adopted here in California
qualifies.point3: You adopted through the Adoption Assistance Program (AAP)
qualifies.point4: Things feel hard right now, and the usual help hasn't been enough
qualifies.reassurance: Always free for AAP families. No referral needed.
qualifies.ctaSecondary: Or see how our program works
qualifies.legal: California High Fidelity Wraparound is authorized under Senate Bill 163 and codified in Welfare and Institutions Code 18250 to 18258.

services.title: Our Services
services.goalTitle: For your family to stay together, and for your child to stay home.
services.goalText: We do that by giving parents the education, the team, and the plan that makes it possible. A Child and Family Team forms around you, you build one Care Plan together, and the team stays until your family can carry it without us.
services.quote: "Our staff is highly qualified in trauma-responsive treatment approaches with children and their families, working under direct supervision of Bryan Post to Jeanette Yoffe, LCSW."

cta.description: Join our wraparound program and get the support your family needs to thrive.
